mutations.name: P1 batch_assemble_edit_project granted to authenticated again (KB-40 reopened)
mutations.sql: do $$ declare f regprocedure; begin for f in select p.oid::regprocedure from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname = 'batch_assemble_edit_project' loop execute format('grant execute on function %s to authenticated', f); end loop; end $$;
